note: Adapted from the English species-level description in Bacchus (1997); the alate section is taken here (soldier and worker sections not taken); type material and figure numbers are omitted.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule orange-yellow to orange, with many minute pale punctures scattered at the setal bases; central spot, anteclypeus and antennae pale yellow, the first two antennal segments darker, brownish on both sides; postclypeus, labrum, body and legs yellow; pronotum distinctly paler than the head capsule. Posterior margin of head capsule arcuate and evenly rounded; setae numerous above the compound eyes and few behind them, none extending beyond the eye bulge; fontanelle absent; central spot oval; the branches of the coronal suture not reaching the ocelli, the main trunk incomplete. Frons smooth; postclypeus shield-shaped, median suture distinct. Compound eyes and ocelli oval, ocelli not touching the compound eyes; labrum length less than width; antennae 15-segmented, segments 3 and 4 shortest and subequal, segments 1, 2 and 5 subequal. Pronotum with numerous setae, without a pale cross-shaped marking, anterior and posterior margins slightly concave; meso- and metanota without a median line, posterior margin moderately concave. Wings extending beyond the body, about ... of body length (the number is missing at this point in the original).
